method: Manual pixel polygons were saved before geometry construction. Every solid's x/z cell belongs to one of those affine-transformed polygons. All coordinates use north screenshot; south offset is not applied to these vertices.
source_date_limit: Screenshots retrieved 26 October 2026; Google copyright year does not establish satellite capture date.
observed_layout: Northwest large brown playing rectangle x approximately12..51,z26..96.
Long narrow roof complex x52..84,z7..87 has FIVE traced pieces: red/brown north end, large light-green upper roof, short adjoining green band, purple mid roof and lower green roof.
Northeast tower roof x113..141,z20..47; height/parallax can shift its observed roof relative to ground footprint.
Small red/brown rounded-end annex x126..141,z48..77, clearly separate from the misplaced old pool footprint. Its function is unverified.

model.field: Brown coarse dirt with muted pale boundary, a representative thin training-court marking and sparse pale bench row. Exact sport markings not legible.
model.upper_gym_interpretation: Only the upper large green roof and adjoining narrow green strip contain representative gym features. Polygon footprint1126 cells, approximately30x38m; not the whole80m roof complex.
model.gym_detail: Oak sports floor, court lines, supported west bleachers facing east, three step aisles, low east team benches, raised boards without central floor posts, side scoreboard, mint/white trims, ties and lanterns.
model.other_long_roof_sections: Generic interconnected rooms, neutral floors, limited benches and clear centre circulation. No assertion that every segment is a gym or that a specific section is the auditorium.
model.tower: 11 provisional4m storeys over traced roof polygon, white facades with cyan strips, repeated windows, internal stairs and open floor circulation. Exact facades and height are inferred.
model.annex: Cream low-rise rounded plan with terracotta roof, entrances and a few representative seats. NO pool basin/water is copied from v2.

material_rationale.roofs: Smooth stone and light gray concrete approximate light gray-green sheet roofs; red terracotta for observed red/brown cap, purple terracotta for observed purple segment. These are visual Minecraft stand-ins, not claims about actual construction materials.
material_rationale.shell: Cream sandstone, white quartz/concrete piers, grey glass.
material_rationale.gym: Mint prismarine/cyan base and white louver rhythms follow local gym reference photographs; wood seats and steel-like neutral rails.
material_rationale.tower: White and cyan repeating bays follow broad photographic cues; exact four facades remain hypothetical.

uncertainties: Affine registration and manual edges have approximately2.5m uncertainty. Roof overhangs do not establish exact wall footprints.
High-rise roof parallax is particularly significant for the northeast tower; using the traced roof as a starting footprint is provisional.
All floor counts/heights except historical11-storey dormitory report, room partitions, stair positions and furnishings are reconstruction decisions.
Gym assignment to the upper approximately30x38m section is consistent with the reported1190m2 scale but is not a labelled floor plan.
The rounded annex is generic; no functional pool label or exact room use is justified by satellite alone.

validation.solid_footprint_check: Every solid x/z belongs to a traced mask.
validation.hall_clearance: x67..70,z8..86 within hall mask remains air at y65..66.
validation.palette: All block names exist in bundled vanilla assets; orientation-sensitive states are explicit.
validation.scope: No gate, statue, campus landscape plane, source v2 or shared scripts modified.
